Carries the Bugsink error-reporting bring-up for the LiteLLM proxy (sentry-sdk init, LiteLLM's native `failure_callback: ["sentry"]` wiring, and the stamped `sentry` Modal secret) via a merge of `mngr/env-tier-sentry`, and inherits the shared `init_sentry` helper's new WARNING-and-above event policy for the startup/migrate window (LiteLLM's own re-init still takes over on the first proxied LLM call, unchanged).
